# Vendored files

`lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` is TradingView Lightweight Charts™
**5.2.1**, copied unchanged from the npm package `lightweight-charts@5.2.1`
(`dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js`), so the site loads no script
from a CDN.

- Licence: Apache License 2.0, in `lightweight-charts.LICENSE`.
- Attribution: `lightweight-charts.NOTICE`, copied from the upstream repository at tag
  v5.2.1. The licence asks for that notice and a link to https://www.tradingview.com/
  on the page. Every page footer carries both, and the chart keeps
  `layout.attributionLogo` on.
